description: UNIT-ORDER (fight): K card says 'Fighting next: <unit> — it has the highest fight-order priority (X vs Y …)', lists the units that can fight now with their priority, and Unit ▶ / ◀ Unit show what selecting each one would do.

steps.comment: seed the AI's score noise so the fight order (and so which unit/target is reached) is the same every run
Setup: decline any stratagem window, then play the AI's own suggested steps (pile-ins) until the 'which unit fights next' decision is reached.
